messages:
Noah: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands pricing segment  a few items from my team: 1) is there a planned "grace window" for quotas during deploys/rollouts so we don't spike customers into overage, 2) how does metering lag affect billing (we've seen delayed usage show up next day and trigger alerts).

Leah (CEO): Good questions. High level: we plan a short grace window for automated rollouts and one-click deploys. Metering lag is known; we're investing in faster eventing but will also add clearer visibility in Console to avoid surprise overages.

Sana (Finance): To add: Finance can honor one-time billing adjustments for deploy-related spikes if you open a support case within 7 days and show rollout evidence. We're also exploring an automated tolerance band for first-time spikes to reduce noise.

Omar (Product): Roadmap note: H2 item to add "deploy-safe mode" for orgs that pauses hard quota enforcement for short, auditable windows (e.g., 10min-2hr) during CI/CD activities. Will include audit events and opt-in flag.

Dev (EngInfra): Clarifying Q: will deploy-safe mode still enforce SLOs/latency? We want to avoid letting heavy deploy traffic degrade other customers.

Jamal (SRE): Deploy-safe mode should only relax billing gating, not runtime QoS. We'll keep CPU/GPU admission controls and per-node caps. Also plan: annotate traffic from deploys so metrics/alerts can filter it out.

Noah: Great. About metering lag  can we expose "estimated usage" in Console (near real-time) vs final billed usage? That would help teams triage.

Omar (Product): Yes, we'll surface an "estimated usage" line with a confidence window and last-update timestamp. Also an explicit note when events are delayed > 1h.

Sana (Finance): And we'll publish a small playbook for customers: how to check estimated vs billed, and steps to dispute an overage. Support will triage with a linkage to deployment IDs.

Dev (EngInfra): Action item: we need an ingress tag for deploys (e.g., X-Redwood-Deployment-ID) so we can correlate requests to deploy windows in metrics + billing. I'll open an infra ticket.

Jamal (SRE): I'll validate that tagged requests are excluded from auto-escalation alerts and that quota accounting still records them for audit.

OpsBot: Internal draft RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfc/deploy-safe-mode (bot)

Noah: Thanks everyone. I'll file a GH issue to track deploy-safe acceptance criteria: TTL options, audit events, ingress header, Console toggle, and finance dispute flow. @Omar @Dev @Sana please add any missing criteria. :thumbsup:

Leah (CEO): Perfect  please keep me posted in the product board.
